definitions.explanation: Having features that distinguish something from others; typical of a particular thing.

examples.japanese: {特徴的|とくちょうてき}な{模様|もよう}がある。
この{地域|ちいき}の{気候|きこう}は{非常|ひじょう}に{特徴的|とくちょうてき}だ。
examples.english: The climate of this region is very distinctive.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はな}し{方|かた}は{特徴的|とくちょうてき}で{忘|わす}れられない。
examples.english: His way of speaking is so distinctive that I can't forget it.

notes:
FORMS:
・{特徴的|とくちょうてき}な + noun (adnominal)
・{特徴的|とくちょうてき}に (adverbially)
・{特徴的|とくちょうてき}だ (predicative)

FORMATION:
{特徴|とくちょう} (characteristic, feature) + {的|てき} (-like, -ic)

USAGE:
Used to describe things that have notable distinguishing features:
・{特徴的|とくちょうてき}な{形|かたち} (distinctive shape)
・{特徴的|とくちょうてき}な{声|こえ} (characteristic voice)
・{特徴的|とくちょうてき}な{症状|しょうじょう} (characteristic symptoms)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{独特|どくとく} - unique, peculiar
・{典型的|てんけいてき} - typical, representative
・{個性的|こせいてき} - individualistic, distinctive
